behaviors.description: Launch selected installed builds through libflatpak and enumerate live instances.
behaviors.preconditions: Two controlled probe apps copy their internal flatpak-info and remain alive until the client releases them.
behaviors.expected: Direct launch succeeds twice; both report version A; distinct enumerated IDs, full app/runtime identities and snapshot-matching info while alive.
references: common/flatpak-instance.c: public enumeration and identity getters

behaviors.description: Track launched instances with caller-owned child watches.
behaviors.preconditions: Two DO_NOT_REAP launches return instances; probes hold lifetime until explicit release.
behaviors.expected: Returned instances have exact live identities and info; watches observe successful exit; retained instances then report not running.

mappings.rationale: Direct library launches synchronize on two real sandbox probes; independently expected commits and identities, distinct enumeration IDs and every sandbox snapshot key are asserted.
DO_NOT_REAP returns exact fixture instances; explicit probe release, successful child watches and post-exit FALSE liveness checked on retained instances.
